title: 強く気高い“ヒシアマゾン”に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By chance, Hishi Amazon catches Narita Brian and Symboli Rudolf together on a partner run. Their intensity has a strong impact on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, she competes in a scrimmage, but her mind is still on Brian. She loses the race, immensely frustrated by her shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She yearns for the strength to compete on Brian's level, and decides that she'll conquer the Triple Tiara—just as Brian takes on the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then finally, they'll have their one-on-one at the year-end Arima Kinen. Goal in mind, Hishi Amazon sets her sights on the Oka Sho.
